# Twemoji · selected graphics

Graphics: Twitter, Inc. and other contributors, including jdecked/twemoji contributors.
Source: https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji
Revision: b6b55fef1e8636b540a6d016a4729ca8cdf2e60b
License: CC BY 4.0, preserved in LICENSE-GRAPHICS.

Selected SVG files are preserved unmodified in overview/assets/shotcraft-figures/.
manifest.json records their source URLs, sizes and SHA-256 hashes. The five
records marked Clareia / desenho local are original local drawings. Clareia
composites these graphics with its own layouts, scale, lighting and shadows.
No source scripts or package code from Twemoji are executed.
